app.name: Internet Archive Channel
app.long_description:
Browse the Internet Archive (archive.org) on your Wii: movies, audio, books, images and the Wayback Machine. Unofficial; not affiliated with the Internet Archive.
Search and browse collections, stream music and old-time radio, watch films, read books page by page (or as text), view images, and visit old websites through the Wayback Machine. Everything downloads over HTTPS directly on the Wii.
Controls: point with the Wii Remote and press A, or use the D-pad. B goes back, + and - scroll or zoom, HOME exits, 1 toggles the performance overlay. GameCube controllers and USB keyboards work too.
